camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore ModifyAccountPassword --region cn-hangzhou --OldAccountPassword oldPassWd9990000 --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --NewAccountPassword newPassWd8880000 --AccountName testaccount
description_en: Modifies the password of a specified account in a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例中指定账号的密码
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-account-password --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --account-name testaccount --old-account-password oldPassWd9990000 --new-account-password newPassWd8880000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAccountPassword

parameters.help_en: The name of the account whose password you want to modify. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473816.html to query the account name
parameters.help_zh: 待修改密码的账号名，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473816.html获取
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The original password of the account.

If you forget the password of the account, you can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473815.html to reset the password
parameters.help_zh:
该账号的原密码。

如果忘记账号的密码，您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473815.html接口重置密码
parameters.name: old_account_password

parameters.help_en: The new password to set for the account. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.help_zh: 该账号要设置的新密码。密码长度为8~32位，需包含大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的至少三种，特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.name: new_account_password

parameters.help_en: This parameter is used only for internal maintenance purposes. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入
parameters.name: source_biz
